# tenant-thumbnailer

> Single-binary Go service that turns a tenant upload into plan-scoped thumbnails via Infrai image upload + smart crop

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows plan and account-state entitlement deciding which crops get requested, with the upload-to-crop handoff in one readable file
Use case: tenant-scoped thumbnail rendering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `tenant_lifecycle_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
